stem: An engineer at Ledger Analytics needs one specific database resource, and whatever depends on it, removed right now, with no edit to any configuration file. Which approach fits that constraint?

choices.text: Delete the resource's block from the configuration and run terraform apply

rationale: destroy -target removes a named resource and its dependents without touching the configuration file, which is exactly what the no-edit constraint calls for. Deleting the resource's block requires editing the configuration first, which the requirement rules out. plan -target only previews the effect on that resource; it does not remove anything. init -upgrade only affects provider and module installation and does not remove any resource.
